items.headline: Mitsubishi Electric's PCI deal reshapes ETRM vendors
items.summary: Industry commentary is debating whether Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions is resetting valuation and consolidation expectations across the ETRM vendor landscape, per CTRM Center analysis.

items.headline: Santander digitalises Brazil trade finance via Komgo
items.summary: Banco Santander became the first Brazilian bank to digitalise trade finance workflows using Geneva fintech Komgo's Konsole platform, timed to Brazil's record trade surplus this year.

items.headline: Tanker crunch drives up delivered crude costs
items.summary: JPMorgan flagged that delivered crude prices have returned to spring highs not from a crude shortage but from the rising cost and difficulty of securing vessels, pressuring European refining margins into negative territory.

items.headline: FIA pushes back on new EMIR Article 7d reporting
items.summary: FIA submitted comments to ESMA on the proposed EMIR Article 7d reporting framework, urging a targeted, proportionate approach to avoid duplicative derivatives reporting obligations for commodity market participants.
